data.title: eTail's After-Hours Game Show. Your Table vs. Everyone.
paragraphs: A live e-commerce news quiz where the audience is the cast. Table teams of six to eight play three rounds built from the year's e-commerce news, and one leaderboard decides the winning table.
It is free, the buses leave the JW Marriott Desert Springs at 6:45 pm, and Talk Commerce and Always Off Brand are hosting.

data.title: The Three Rounds
data.subtitle: The questions come from the year in e-commerce news. Here is a taste of each round.

items.title: Who's Brent This Time?
items.text: Scott reads a real quote from the year in e-commerce news and your table names who said it. Try this one. Purchases by its AI agent are "considered transactions authorized by you." Which retailer wrote that into its terms?

items.title: Bluff the Listener
items.text: Three people from the audience read three strange stories. One is true, and your table votes. The sample theme is "My AI agent did WHAT?" with three shopping-agent disasters, two of them invented.

items.title: Lightning Fill-in-the-Blank
items.text: Your table rep gets 45 seconds of rapid-fire blanks, and a miss lets the room steal it. Try this one. In 2026, Amazon moved Prime Day from July to ____.

data.title: How the Night Works
data.subtitle: About 60 minutes, hosted by Scott Ohsman of Always Off Brand and Brent Peterson of Talk Commerce.

steps.title: Grab a table
steps.text: Come with your team or join one at the door. Six to eight people per table.

steps.title: Play three rounds
steps.text: Name the quote, spot the true story, then race through rapid-fire blanks.

steps.title: Win for your table
steps.text: One leaderboard runs the whole night. The top table takes the grand prize.

data.eyebrow: How the heck are we getting there?
data.title: We Are Taking Buses
paragraphs: Buses pick up at the JW Marriott Desert Springs at 6:45 pm on Tuesday, February 23, 2027. Nobody drives, nobody hunts for an Uber, and your whole table rides together.
The exact pickup spot and the ride back come with the venue announcement.

items.question: When is it?
items.answer: Tuesday, February 23, 2027, during eTail Palm Springs. Buses leave at 6:45 pm, and the show time comes with the venue announcement.

items.question: Where is it?
items.answer: Venue announced soon. We are booking a bar with a stage in the Palm Springs area, within 30 minutes of the JW Marriott Desert Springs.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It is completely free. There is a cost to having to endure Scott and Brent.

items.question: What is the dress code?
items.answer: Most places in Palm Springs require you to wear clothes. We don't care what you wear, just wear something.

items.question: Can my company sponsor the night?
items.answer: Yes. Headline, round, bar and table packages are on the sponsor page.

data.title: Save Your Table's Seats
data.text: RSVP once for yourself, then add your teammates' names so we can hold a table for you.
